name: Herald Ossian
title: The Crown's Word
examine: Reads the Line's decrees in a voice that fills the hall, then spends the rest of the day saving his own. The tabard is madder crimson and immaculate.
lines: Hall at morning bell, Grand Court at midday. The word walks down the stair so the city need not walk up.
I read what the Crown writes. What I think is kept in a smaller voice, for after supper.
Hear the word and mind the edge. That second part is mine. The Crown lets me keep it.
